newsitem.title: UK: Dragon lifts volume again as bid talk swirls.
newsitem.headline: Dragon lifts volume again as bid talk swirls.

text.p: Continued massive trading activity in oil exploration group Dragon Oil Plc, driven by persistent takeover speculation, boosted SEAQ volume by 59 million shares on Wednesday afternoon.
Overall volume was 640 million and on Tuesday the stock accounted for more than ten percent of total SEAQ trade.
"The talk is that one of the major oil companies might buy Dragon as a cheap way into China and the Far East where Dragon is big," said one dealer.
Dealers note speculation that a bidder may be interested in Dragon's 60 percent stake in Larmag Energy, a private company whose principal assets are in the Caspian Sea.
"We have no comment to make and we will not be releasing a statement," said a spokeswoman.
The stock price was unchanged at 4p.
